g.text: GPU slider | Where progress slows, and where it restarts
Full real catalog throughout · M11: steps 69–91 · M15: 91–109 · M19: 109–113
M15 ends with loss 0.0240 and gradient 0.00579. At the same curve, adding M19 directions raises the gradient to 81.2.
Four M19 steps then remove 99.7% of that loss. This supports stagnation within the smaller update space, not a globally vanished gradient.
